Reem Al Khaleej Perfumes
brand board

The mark joins three ideas: the arch of a Gulf doorway, a single drop of perfume, and a four-point star from the night sky over the desert. It is drawn with two strokes and two fills so it stays clear from a browser tab to a shopfront.

Typography

Fraunces

Wordmark and headlines. Soft, warm serif with a human hand.

Perfumes

Manrope Bold, tracked wide, for the descriptor line.

ريم الخليج للعطور

Amiri for the Arabic name: a calligraphic naskh with classical proportions.

Usage

Clear space

Keep the width of the star clear on every side of the lockup.

Minimum size

Mark: 20 px wide. Horizontal lockup: 160 px wide. Below that, use the mark alone.

Colour

Brass on ivory, gold on oud. On brass or photography use the single-ink version.
